content: Skill-Link is an AI-powered service marketplace connecting clients with verified local skilled workers. It allows natural problem descriptions, automatic intent detection, transparent upfront pricing, and seamless booking.

For highway car breakdowns, main pipe bursts, or electrical short circuits, Skill-Link dispatches emergency verified technicians within 15-20 minutes and connects to 24/7 national helplines: Police (112), Highway SOS (1033), Gas Leak (1906).
All Skill-Link service estimates provide an itemized breakdown including visiting diagnosis fee (₹149–₹199), estimated labor, and platform safety guarantee fee (₹20). No hidden costs.
Workers are trade-certified with background checks across categories: Plumber, Electrician, Car & Bike Mechanic, AC Repair, Home Cleaning, Appliance Repair, Carpentry, and Locksmith.
